# Smart Stage

> Smart Stage is a desktop app for macOS and Windows that plays audio, video and image cues for live performances, with phone or tablet remote control.

The dedicated Admin window manages original local media files, playlists, button colors, audio outputs and a stage display. Features include image or looping-video backgrounds, optional background sound, audio fades and crossfades, and independent Stage on/off controls. Media and playback stay on the computer.

Desktop downloads support ARM64 and Intel/AMD64. Mac builds target macOS 12 or newer; Windows 11 is the intended Windows baseline. Desktop updates install automatically on launch before playback starts.

Admin supports English and Italian, selecting the system's preferred supported language with a saved manual override. The phone/tablet remote uses its own browser language and independent manual choice. The website has localized animated tutorials for media, outputs and remote setup.

Public gateway mode is the default and requires a configured server and internet access. The separate static Linux gateway supports ARM64 and AMD64, with systemd and an nginx or Caddy HTTPS reverse proxy. Local LAN control is an alternative. Admin listens only on 127.0.0.1. The gateway forwards control traffic, not media.

## Project

- [Website](https://arizzi74.github.io/Smart-Stage/): selects English or Italian using a saved choice or browser language.
- [English website](https://arizzi74.github.io/Smart-Stage/en/): English product overview and installation.
- [Sito in italiano](https://arizzi74.github.io/Smart-Stage/it/): presentazione e installazione in italiano.
- [Website overview in Markdown](https://arizzi74.github.io/Smart-Stage/index.md): readable overview, commands, downloads and first-show setup.
- [Panoramica in italiano in Markdown](https://arizzi74.github.io/Smart-Stage/it/index.md): comandi, download e configurazione iniziale in italiano.
- [Repository](https://github.com/arizzi74/Smart-Stage): source, issues and project history.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/arizzi74/Smart-Stage/releases/latest): desktop and gateway downloads with checksums.
